description: After a .xaml or .cs edit, ask the DevServer (uno-devserver app hot-reload-status) whether the running Uno app applied it through Hot Reload and tell the agent the result, so it asserts with uno_app_find_elements, fixes the reported compile errors, or restarts only for a rude edit or a DevServer internal error. Without the CLI or the status tool, remind it that Hot Reload applies the edit. Before a shell dotnet build, deny it when the App MCP route is available: uno_app_start is the build. Before uno_app_restart, or a uno_app_start that repeats a launch the session already made, deny it when the last Hot Reload verdict was applied and the last edit was not startup code: the app already runs the current code.
